ev.q: Poly Bridge is a bridge-building simulation-puzzle game
Poly Bridge is a bridge-building simulation-puzzle game
In each level (more than 100 overall), there are two requirements
There is also a sandbox mode that allows free building without restrictions
the bridge has to be strong enough for a specific number of cars
The objective of the game is to build bridges to allow vehicles to cross them
The game is made more difficult with the availability of different building materials of different prices
